#  the second time one round after the first was caught, written down and corrected --
#  which is why this is a tracked file checked mechanically rather than a habit.
#  A receipt says a review was CONVENED and recorded against the commit it reviewed.
#  It says NOTHING about whether the review was any good; nothing mechanical can.
#  *** seats-ANSWERING IS NOT seats-READ, AND THIS FILE USED TO CONFLATE THEM. ***  A
#  completeness audit on 2026-08-16 found panel_20260816_003524 recorded here as "9of9"

#  the Opus agent alone.  Reading them produced two surviving mutants and a false record,
#  all of which the panel had already found and none of which had reached the code.  The
#  old single column was green for any value of the question that matters, which is the
#  `constblind` shape exactly.  Both numbers are now recorded, and seats-READ is the one
#  that means anything: a panel is not complete when its seats have answered, only when
#  they have been read.  Backfilled honestly, including where the honest answer is 1of9.
